sources.title: Toxic-classifier/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: A lightweight NLP project that classifies toxic comments using a 3-step text cleaning pipeline, 1 TF-IDF vectorizer, and 1 ML model. The classifier predicts 6 toxicity categories and achieves strong performance with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics.

sources.title: GitHub - Vishwajyothireshmi/toxic-text-classifier: An AI-powered system ...
sources.snippet: This project aims to detect toxic comments using a fine-tuned BERT model. It leverages deep learning and transformer-based NLP techniques to classify user-generated comments as toxic or non-toxic, helping moderate harmful content online.
